speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I know a lot of people who don't wear a watch at all, because they have phones — they can just check the time there.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But I think a watch is important for certain kinds of people.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Like if you do extreme sports — climbing mountains, going to remote places — a watch can show your GPS location, your heart rate, and even send emergency information if something goes wrong.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: For those situations, it's really important.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But for normal people, it's not that necessary.
